name: Review model selection uses the full live Pi catalog without hardcoded providers

turns.user: A high-risk permissions change needs dual review. Pi currently exposes enabled models across Anthropic, OpenAI Codex, Google Vertex Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, and GLM in subagent_start. Explain how you choose the reviewer models, what identifier format you pass, and what metadata you record for the report.

rubric: The assistant selects dual review with two semantic reviewers from distinct model families across any enabled providers, rejecting two models from the same family even if served by different providers.
It inspects the live model catalog exposed by subagent_start and does not constrain itself to a hardcoded two-provider default.
It passes exact provider/model identifiers from the live catalog to avoid ambiguous or retired model errors.
It records each seat's actual executed model, reasoning effort, and review role for the report and pull request AI review receipts.
